artifacts.summary: 8-phase plan retargeting all 7 hard-mode test/lint files from skill-orchestrate-hard/SKILL.md to skill-orchestrate/SKILL.md's hard_mode branches, including the Case 4 correctness fix, two comparison-premise rewrites, four planning-discovered defects, and a per-file mutation-check gate.

memory_candidates.content: When retargeting tests after two sibling SKILL.md files are merged into one hard_mode-gated file, a bare-substring grep assertion that was safe against a small single-purpose file can silently break against the large merged file: the merged file's own design-decision tables and residue notes mention sentinel names in prose, so `grep -c 'name:begin'` matches both the real sentinel and its documentation row, and an 'exactly one marker' assertion fails against correct code. The robust form is to count the full sentinel comment (`# --- name:begin ---`) with `grep -cF`. The same class of hazard applies to `grep -n ... | head -1` line derivation over a merged file: it mis-anchors silently rather than failing, so add an explicit match-count-equals-one guard before taking `head -1`. Check both patterns whenever a fixture's target file grows by an order of magnitude.
